rows.TEXT:
Primitive Giant 
"Must... pro-tect... the lady. Old bones... crush!"

Trainer 
"So, someone finally dealt with the damned giant! He sure managed to ruin my business down here! Anyway, my training grounds are now open for business again. If ya want to get in shape quickly, please pass by, your money is always welcome!"

Spearman 
"I knew we should never have accepted this rotten job...we'll charge the demons with you, but any treasure along the way is ours!

Ashkael 
"At last! It took us several months to decimate the Empire frontlines, but we are finally within reach of the cursed Life Orb!"

Peasant 
"The city is in flames! The demonic presence has disturbed the dead dragon! How can we escape with the beast on one side and the demons on the other?"

Man at Arms 
"There is no way I'm standing against a dragon! We've got better chances with the demons!"

Ashkael 
"Ah, perfect! You don't even have to chase your victims in this country; fresh meat delivers itself to your door! I we'll grow to love this place!"

Ranger 
"Sorry Milord, I haven't been able to reach the king or our men defending the Great Line. I stumbled upon a large group of orcs and goblins around the ruins of Blackthorne, many of them are marching toward Katras."

Pegasus Knight 
"It appears we underestimated the orcish threat while confronting our dark enemies. 
We must defend Katras at all cost! The Life Orb Must be protected; who knows what horrors could be unleashed if it falls into enemy hands."

Elf Lord 
"Our mages think moving the Life Orb away from its original location could render the artifact useless. We will need more time in order to discover anything useful from the Orb. You must fend off any disturbances coming this way!"

Acolyte 
"We didn't anticipate conflict to come this way so early, we still haven't completed our defenses. We'll need all the help available in order to defend neighboring cities."

Pegasus Knight 
"We will do all in our power to protect your work."

Ranger 
"I wish you luck my friends! I'll will continue with my message for the king. 
There must be a safe passage somewhere."

Pegasus Knight 
"We did it gentlemen! We reclaimed our province from our enemies and now that the Orcish threat is gone, we'll have no problem dealing with the remnants of the Undead and Demon forces!"

Skeleton Champion 
"In life, I was the dragon's master. In death, our roles reverse...I guess this way, our score is settled. Oh, sorry for rattling my bone box like this... I rarely have the chance to talk to those I'm about to kill."

Ashkael 
"We will blaze our way through your crippled tower and your insignificant dragon! Maybe your sense of humor will be better appreciated in Hell."

Squire 
"We received many accounts of missing farm animals and even farmers in the Fergal City neighborhood...maybe we should investigate?"

Squire 
"Neighboring farmers have informed us that Goblins have settled in an abandoned farm south of Fergal City! That must be why people are disappearing!"

Rock Giant 
"This place is now my house! Go find another, little one!"

Lich Queen 
"There is ssssomething intriguing about the Witch's activities. We discovered she's controlling the wolves which were ssstealing bones from our graveyards. We now know for sure she has been collecting those ssstolen bones... but to what end?"

Lich Queen 
"Lord, we have discovered sssomething absolutely atrocious! The witch is creating undead sssservants. Those mindless creatures are an insult to our goddess and must be put back to rest as ssssoon as possible."

Ashgan 
"This sssacrilegious artifact, the Life Orb, evaded us for too long now! The human king is gone waging war against the demons, leaving the elven ssscholars behind with the life Orb and little defenders. Our days of hiding are over!"

Wraith 
"Yes! We mussst dessstroy this artifact before the elvess dissscover its full potential... But I fear we'll have other matters to sssolve first."

Lich Queen 
"Wolves have been ssstealing bones from our graveyards in increasssing numbers lately. The animals act ssstrangely and they attack our followers. Some kind of sssorcery is bound to be involved in all this!"

Red Thirst 
"The wolves patrol the route to Katras, but beyond them, Katras is still blocked! A powerful witch established herself west of here and managed to seal the only passage we had into that territory."

Arch-Angel 
"Don't worry, good people of Old Rock, we've come to help you in your battle against the Orcish horde."

Kaleros 
"Who said you were welcome here, imperial lackeys? When we told you about the orcs a few years ago, your king laughed at us. We can handle ourselves."

Pegasus Knight 
"We apologize, The upcoming war forced us to neglect our neighbors to monitor the Demons' progress. We need your help; your city would make the perfect launching point for our attacking forces."

Kaleros 
"That's too bad. The next time you need a favor from someone, try not to look the other way while orcs kill his brothers and eat his children!"

Arch-Angel 
"Perhaps we should seek aid from Old Rock; the city is located next to Blackthorne's ruins. Some people say the village was been founded by the great warriors who once defended this formidable fortress centuries ago."

Pegasus Knight 
"Indeed. It shows in their descendants. The city's location would be ideal to launch our attack against the Orcish stronghold. 
We won't know peace as long as those ruins are still standing."

Skeleton Champion 
"Sorry to let you down. I would certainly enjoy joining your little party but my soul belongs to someone else...yet I was immensely entertained, we must do this again sometime!"

Skeleton Champion 
"Hehehe! Miss me? Who wants to have some more fun?"

Ashkael 
"The Orb! It is so painfully pure, yet with its power in our hands, we'll be able to accomplish so much! We shall reverse its powers to scorch the land and harvest the souls of the mortals!"

Ashgan 
"Sacrilegiousss relic, be gone and trouble the dead no more!"

Elf Lord 
"We still have much left to decipher with the Life Orb! We will notify you when our work has produced something useful."

Nosferat 
"Apparently, the Elven party studying the Life Orb was killed by another of the Empire's enemies.The Life Orb was damaged during the confrontation and is now completely wasted. The dead will be troubled by this abomination no more."

Titan 
"Go away Demons if you seek to remain attached to your unholy heads!"

Thug 
"I already told you - the Dwarves didn't dig a passage through the mountains yet."

Thug 
"And where do you suggest we go then? Through the Demons' den?"

Master Thug 
"Silence, both of you! The Demons aren't that far yet."

Baen Goblinbane 
"Goblins! Those foul creatures can drive a province into chaos if left unopposed. We'd better crush their nest before they drive all of us mad."

Peasant 
"Thank you Milord! Those thugs had been robbing all they could from us for a couple months now. Please accept this humble gift to express our gratitude. It isn't much, but this is the only thing the thugs overlooked."

Peasant 
"The rivers have been ridden of the merfolk at last! We just discovered these near the waterfalls; the merfolk probably took them from other seafarers. Since you bested them, I guess these belong to you."

Elf Lord 
"We've discovered the incantations for a powerful healing spell within the Life Orb! As promised, we will share this knowledge with you."

Elf Lord 
"The Life Orb has granted us a very powerful healing spell. It should bring health to a large number of soldiers with each use."

Orc Champion 
"Urh...pretty thing in that chest...What could it be for?

Lich Queen 
"These gravesss have been disturbed! How horrible! This isn't the goddess' will, the damn witch is bound to be involved in thisss! We'll teach her to ressspect our Queen!"

Lich Queen 
"Here's one of the graveyards the witch profaned! The souls seem lost and disturbed. We shall deliver the corpses to Mortis."

Orc Champion 
"Humans think they're tough urh? Blackthorne's boys don't think so. 
Squish the Humans!"

Pegasus Knight 
"They're already at our doors! Quick! Reinforce our cities and prepare for the attack!"

Tifhaen Gravespark 
"Why? Why is this witch still breathing? Mortis can't suffer this insolent being's presence anymore. She awakened me from the grave to put an end to thisss humiliating situation."

Voramel Dragonbane 
"So, a dead dragon is still holds our progress? The fiery lords are disappointed by your lack of action. I have been dispatched to dispose of this creature."

Duke 
"The tower's fall granted us passage through the mountains at last! The Empire strongholds should be located to the north. 
If the Life Orb isn't around, we'll surely find a feeble mind willing to tell us where they've taken it."

Duke 
"You will talk to us, human. We will char your flesh slowly until your skin is gone."

Priest 
"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAARH! 
I told you, you're wasting your time demon! I'll never tell you anything! 
Kill me, torture me...the High Father will shield my soul against your worst torments."

Succubus 
"Enough!  Leave this poor man alone, demon! There, pour soul, lay down and take this!"

Priest 
"My wounds... they've healed! You're a healer?"

Succubus 
"I hate to see suffering as much as you do, priest. Let me help you, I could make you feel so much better! If only..."

Succubus 
"If only we could reach these...vile creatures. If we could give them what they want, they would leave this place and leave your people alone... leave us alone."

Priest 
"Yes...yes, I see. Your eyes...they're so...the Life Orb is north of here, milady, north of Katras, on an island protected by high mountains. Tell them this...we can be alone."

Succubus 
"That's a good boy! I'll take care of you, you'll never even understand your treason...and in the end, your soul shall be mine! But you don't understand anymore do you? You have the information you looked for, Duke, you can leave us now."

Duke 
"And miss the show? No, missing such an artist's performance, even a part of it, would be torture. I'll stay and watch you work...milady...ha ha ha!"

Lich Queen 
"The witch's sssorcery vanished! We are now free to invade the land of the living. The Humans' main cities are located north of here, the Life Orb mussst be inside one of them."

Lich Queen 
"Can you feel it? The vilenesss around here causesss even my putrid bones to quake."

Death Knight 
The Life Orb is near, guarded by Humans...and Elves. I can't wait to deliver more of those "immortals" into Mortis' eternal embrace."
In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in her times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended her reign of terror. She is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to her will.
